bulk_import.description:
Paste a YAML list of devices. Each item is one device: a single entity, a device with several `components`, or a TF8040 `object`.

```yaml
- name: Socket
  platform: switch
  adsvar: HA.Living.bSocket1
- name: Living room
  components:
    - platform: light
      name: Ceiling
      adsvar: HA.Living.stCeilLed.bOn
      adsvar_brightness: HA.Living.stCeilLed.nBrightness
    - platform: binary_sensor
      name: Window
      adsvar: HA.Living.bWindow1
      device_class: window
- object: MAIN.FSZ.Living.Presence
```{detail}
bulk_import.title: Import devices

confirm_cannot_connect.description:
`{adsvar}` could not be checked, because the PLC did not answer: {error}

Saving it anyway adds a device whose entity stays unavailable until the variable exists and the ADS integration is reloaded.
confirm_cannot_connect.title: [%key:component::ads::config_subentries::device::step::confirm_not_loaded::title%]

confirm_not_found.description: The PLC does not know `{adsvar}`. Saving it anyway adds a device whose entity stays unavailable until the variable exists and the ADS integration is reloaded.
confirm_not_found.title: [%key:component::ads::config_subentries::device::step::confirm_not_loaded::title%]

confirm_not_loaded.description: `{adsvar}` could not be checked, because the ADS connection is not set up. Saving it anyway adds a device whose entity becomes available once the connection is set up, if the PLC has the variable.
confirm_not_loaded.title: Save the variable without checking it?

confirm_unknown_type.description: `{adsvar}` is of type `{type}`, which could not be confirmed as a `BOOL`. Save it anyway if the type is an alias of `BOOL`.

deprecated_yaml.description:
Configuring the {integration_title} connection using YAML is being removed. Your existing connection configuration has been imported into the UI automatically.

Remove the `{domain}` key from your configuration.yaml file and restart Home Assistant to fix this issue. Entities configured with `platform: {domain}` are not affected by this change and keep working.
deprecated_yaml.title: The {integration_title} YAML configuration is being removed

deprecated_yaml_import_issue_invalid_net.description: Configuring {integration_title} using YAML is being removed. While importing your YAML configuration, the AMS NetID turned out to be invalid. Fix the connection settings and restart Home Assistant to try again, or remove the `{domain}` key from your configuration and set up the integration in the UI. Your ADS entities defined in YAML keep working once the connection is set up.
deprecated_yaml_import_issue_invalid_net.title: The {integration_title} YAML configuration import failed
